feeds.title: The Learning Age
feeds.description: Paul Stanistreet is a writer and editor who believes that education can help make the world a fairer, more equal, democratic and just place. Follow this blog about adult education and learning by Paul Stanistreet.

feeds.title: European Lifelong Learning Magazine
feeds.description: European Lifelong Learning Magazine is a free online magazine on lifelong learning and adult education. It is the only journalistic medium of adult education with a European scope and with a continent-wide correspondent network. The magazine keeps you on the pulse of what's happening in the field of adult education in Europe.

feeds.title: Adult Learning Australia
feeds.description: Adult Learning Australia (ALA) is the national peak body for the Adult and Community Education fields. They are a not-for-profit entity with both organizational and individual members in all States and Territories who reflect the diversity of adult and community education.

feeds.title: Aontas
feeds.description: AONTAS is Ireland's national adult learning organization for adult and community education providers and adult learners. It promotes the value and benefits of adult learning and advocates on behalf of the sector.

feeds.title: Sam Shepherd
feeds.description: Sam Shepherd is an ESOL teacher and occasional teacher trainer from the UK. He is interested in teaching, obviously, but particular in language teaching, teaching with technology, professional development for teachers and professionals in the lifelong learning sector generally.

feeds.title: Adult Learners Week
feeds.description: Adult Learners Week is a UNESCO initiative supported in Australia by the Commonwealth Department of Education and Training and coordinated by Adult Learning Australia. Follow this blog to know more about adult learners week.

feeds.title: thelearningprofessor
feeds.description: I'm interested in lifelong learning. Keen on social justice, history, the environment, rugby, cinema, music, theatre, reading, hills, real ale, and a small Scotswoman. Follow this blog to know about lifelong learning written by John Field.

feeds.title: Learning and Work Institute
feeds.description: Learning & Work institute's vision is for a prosperous and fair society in which learning and work provide opportunities for everyone to realize their potential and ambitions. We work with a wide range of partners and stakeholders to support the learning and skills sector in providing more and better opportunities for all adults, and to advance the case for adult learning among policy-makers.

feeds.title: Whole Family Learning
feeds.description: Kerry McDonald is an education policy writer whose articles have appeared in Forbes, Newsweek, NPR, Education Next, Natural Mother Magazine, and Green Child Magazine, among others. Follow this blog written by Kerry McDonald that gives information on family learning for adults.

feeds.title: Miami Dade Adult Continuing Education
feeds.description: Miami Dade Adult Continuing Education is an adult & career technical continuing education programs in Miami-Dade County. We are focused on providing career-oriented technical courses training. Learn more about our Adult Education program by following this feed.

feeds.title: Rick Osborn's Continuing Education Blog
feeds.description: Follow Rick Osborn's Continuing Education Blog to get the discussion on continuing higher education, adult education, training, and some related topics.

feeds.title: Adult Education Matters
feeds.description: Get information and inspiration to renew and rebuild Adult Education from Adult Education Matters.

feeds.title: San Mateo Adult School
feeds.description: The San Mateo Adult School is a catalyst for student intellectual growth, creativity, and sustained health. We develop skilled workers, strong families, successful communities by offering opportunities to learn at every stage of adult life.

feeds.title: SAVE YOUR ADULT SCHOOL
feeds.description: This blog is created for the sole purpose of sharing information about the fate of adult education. subscribe to this blog and receive notifications of new posts.

feeds.title: Lifelong Learning Centre
feeds.description: The Lifelong Learning Centre is about creating opportunities so that people of any age are not bound for their lifetimes by the decisions and experiences of their past. The Lifelong Learning Centre offers courses and services for part-time, mature and foundation level undergraduate students at the University of Leeds.

feeds.title: Lifelong Learning Platform - European Civil Society for Education
feeds.description: The Lifelong Learning Platform is an umbrella that gathers 42 European organizations active in the field of education, training, and youth. They cover all sectors of education and training including networks for higher education, vocational education and training, adult education and popular education.
